name: Jork Leonhardt
description: Jork Leonhardt is co-founder of Corpus Core GmbH, building colibri.stateless, a trustless client for blockchain data verification. He previously served as COO at slock.it, creators of the Universal Sharing Network and Ethereum's IN3/Incubed light client, and co-founded Tokenize.it, a regulated platform tokenizing profit participation rights that represent startup equity. His background spans strategy consulting, aerospace, renewable energy and regulated finance.
